test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Lima's father is four times as old as Lima. Four years ago, his father was six times as old as he was then. Find the present age of his father.
solution:
Consider Lima = L and Lima's father = F.

Lima's father is four times as old as Lima

⇒ F = 4L ............. (1)

Four years ago, his father was six times as old as he was

⇒ F - 4 = 6(L - 4) 

⇒ F - 4 = 6L - 24

⇒ 6L
